user.title: Eni Plenitude customer area
user.description: The credentials you use on eniplenitude.com/my-eni. The password is used only when the session (30 days) expires.

supply.title: Supply
supply.description: The account has more than one electricity supply: choose the one to import. Add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Plenitude again
reauth_confirm.description: Plenitude refused the login for {email}: enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: Credentials refused by Plenitude (or an additional verification is required).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Plenitude customer area.
error.no_supplies: The account has no electricity supply with the consumption analysis.
error.supply_missing: The configured supply is no longer in this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error: see the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Energy price
init.description: Plenitude does not expose the price of the offer: enter it to get the cost too. If you change it, the cost of the whole history is recomputed with the new price.

prices.title: Prices per kWh
prices.description: Prices in euro per kWh. For a cost close to the real one use an all-inclusive price (total of a bill divided by the billed kWh); the energy price of the offer alone gives a lower cost.
